














  Keyboard shortcuts

  Compose                                              Session
  !                     Shell Mode                     enter                 Send / steer
  ctrl+j                New line                       tab                   Queue for next turn
  / / @ / $             Pick command / file / skill    alt+↑ / shift+←       Edit last queued
  arrows                Move caret / input history     shift+↑ / shift+↓     Raise / lower reasoning
  ctrl+← / ctrl+→       Previous / next word           /status /session      Settings / launch metrics
  alt/option+← / →      Previous / next word           /copy                 Copy response or part of it
  ctrl+↑ / ctrl+↓       Start / end of line            /btw QUESTION         Side question / follow-up
  alt/option+backspace  Delete previous word           /model /effort /tier  Open picker or set VALUE
  ctrl+w / alt+del      Delete previous / next word    ctrl+c                Clear / interrupt / quit
  ctrl+k                Delete to end of line          esc                   Interrupt, keep draft
  ctrl+z / ctrl+y       Undo / redo                    ctrl+b 1–5            Focus pane
  ctrl+v                Paste image                    J (empty draft)       Open journal
  ctrl+g                External editor                ctrl+b e              Next live item
                                                       ctrl+b q / !          Questions / error details
                                                       ctrl+b ← / →          Resize panes

  Transcript
  ctrl+e       Default / events / all
  pgup / pgdn  Scroll
  esc          Back to bottom

  ? / esc  Close shortcuts
